page_title: MNT 1-3 NAN | Montpellier v Nantes 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Benoit Millot is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Montpellier have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+5' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
90+4' Akor Adams (Montpellier) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Montpellier have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) will replace Tino Kadewere.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Alban Lafont gets down to his right to keep it out.
89' The ball is cleared after Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
85' 1 - 3 Goal! Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is teed up on the edge of the box by Tino Kadewere, and his howitzer of a shot into the roof of the net gives the keeper no chance. 1:3.
85' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) gets booked for the first time in this match.
85' Alban Lafont (Nantes) receives a yellow card.
84' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the middle of the target, but Alban Lafont keeps it out.
83' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) replacing Moses Simon.
83' That's the end of the game for Marcus Coco, who is replaced by Louis Leroux (Nantes).
82' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
81' Marcus Coco (Nantes) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
80' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
78' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) fails to convert the free kick from the edge of the box. His shot goes right into the stands. High, wide and not at all handsome.
75' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Montpellier have a free kick from a promising distance.
74' Antoine Kombouare has decided to make a change. Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) replaces Matthis Abline.
74' Today's match ends for Sorba Thomas who will be replaced by Kelvin Amian (Nantes).
73' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
71' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) plays a through ball but overhits it.
70' A cross into the box picks out Falaye Sacko (Montpellier), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
68' Nantes couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
64' Nantes have been awarded a corner kick.
63' An attempted cross from Moses Simon (Nantes) is cleared. Nantes force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
63' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Tanguy Coulibaly is replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) is replacing Mousa Al-Tamari.
61' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
60' Looks like Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
57' It looks like Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) saw red with that tackle. Benoit Millot won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
56' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
54' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Akor Adams (Montpellier) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
52' It will be a corner kick for Montpellier.
50' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
49' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
47' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' Benoit Millot has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+7' 1 - 2 Goal! Moses Simon (Nantes) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Benjamin Lecomte into right side of the goal.
45+7' Moses Simon (Nantes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+6' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Nantes!
45+6' Referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Nantes. Let’s see what happens!
45+4' Surely that's handball by one of the Montpellier players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
45+4' Nantes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45+4' Moses Simon (Nantes) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Benjamin Lecomte, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Nantes will take a corner.
45+1' My Gran could have done better! Matthis Abline (Nantes) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) picks up an injury.
44' Montpellier quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
44' The corner is swung in but Montpellier can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Good work from Montpellier as they win a corner.
42' Matthis Abline (Nantes) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Montpellier comes to nothing.
41' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Montpellier force their opponents to concede a corner.
40' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) is being substituted because of an injury. Michel Der Zakarian sends Rabby Nzingoula on the pitch.
36' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
35' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
34' Matthis Abline (Nantes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Nantes can continue in their attacking effort.
33' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nantes was in an offside position.
33' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Benoit Millot signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Montpellier players celebrate.
31' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Montpellier players aren’t happy.
30' 1 - 1 Goal! Akor Adams (Montpellier) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.

30' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Alban Lafont was alert and the score remained the same.
30' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
27' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
26' Matthis Abline (Nantes) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.
26' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Montpellier players have a reason to celebrate!
25' The Nantes players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

24' 0 - 1 Goal! Tino Kadewere finds Matthis Abline (Nantes) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the bottom left corner. Fantasy football! 0:1.
21' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier). Benoit Millot saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
19' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
18' Montpellier can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Montpellier.
18' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play and Montpellier manage to earn a corner.
15' Matthis Abline (Nantes) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
11' Problems for Michel Der Zakarian as Issiaga Sylla is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) replaces him.
10' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
8' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Benjamin Lecomte.
6' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
5' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
3' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alban Lafont, who smothers the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Benoit Millot.
